_meta.purpose: Reusable strategic-analysis patterns the service can offer users. Each pattern is a recipe: deterministic computation (Swiss Ephemeris / KB lookup) first, symbolic interpretation last, always labelled with provenance. Emits Insight objects (see backend/services/strategic/layers.py).
_meta.layer_refs: Layer enum values used below match backend/services/strategic/layers.py: astronomy=1.0, astrology_symbolic=0.8, user_context=0.9, age_psychology=0.9, llm_narrative=0.7.
hard_rules: Deterministic math (positions, houses, transits, void-of-course) is computed, never LLM-generated.
Every surfaced statement carries Source + Confidence; symbolic reading never overrides a hard layer.
No deterministic language (no 'will/будет/точно') — enforced by no_determinism.py.
Every interpretive output carries the reflective/entertainment disclaimer (disclaimer.py).
PII of third parties is never analysed; physiognomy patterns are self-reflection only (western.json ethics_note).
_meta.provenance_of_this_file: Distilled from OneiroScope session 2026-07 (owner's own natal analysis + Fandorin reverse-physiognomy). Each pattern was first run by hand, then generalised.

offers.ru: Как у тебя устроены деньги и где потолок дохода
offers.en: How your money works and where the ceiling is

steps: 2nd house cusp sign + ruler + ruler's house/sign/dignity
8th house cusp sign + ruler + ruler's house/sign/dignity; occupants of 8th
Part of Fortune (day: ASC+Moon-Sun; night: ASC+Sun-Moon) with sect from Sun's house
linchpin detector: are the 2nd- and 8th-house rulers within <=8 deg (same money engine)?
11th house (gain-from-career) ruler + occupants

rules: 2nd = personal earning STYLE (salaried vs self-generated vs dealing), from cusp sign + ruler placement (house of ruler = where income flows)
8th = shared/other-people's money, investment, leverage; strong/tenanted 8th or Node in 8th => wealth ceiling higher via capital than salary
linchpin present => personal and investment income are one engine (dealer/investor/broker archetype)
Part of Fortune house/sign = domain of felt prosperity/ease; its dispositor's house refines it
dignified money ruler => strong instinct for value/price

offers.ru: Кем тебе быть — кластеры подходящих профессий с обоснованием
offers.en: What you could be — profession clusters with rationale

steps: MC sign + MC ruler (house/sign)
planets conjunct MC (<=8 deg)
2nd/6th/10th house tenancy + rulers
planets in essential dignity (own sign/exaltation)
angular planets (in 1/4/7/10)

rules: MC + MC-ruler placement = core public-role signal; MC-ruler's house shows the arena
planet conjunct MC colours the public image (e.g. Neptune=vision/brand/image)
dignified + angular planets = amplified talents => name the cluster they support
cluster the signals into 3-5 vocation families, each cited to its placement
flag the 'sweet spot' = combination that engages both the strongest earning signal and the strongest expression signal

offers.ru: Разбор ближайшего десятилетия по годам: фазы, окна старта и урожая
offers.en: Year-by-year decade breakdown: phases, launch and harvest windows

steps: for each year: Saturn/Jupiter/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto sign, degree, natal house transited
conjunctions/hard aspects of transiting slow planets to natal points (orb <=1.5)
planetary returns (Saturn return, Jupiter return) and their exact windows
ingresses of slow planets over natal angles (ASC/MC/IC/DSC)

rules: Saturn's natal-house transit = the life area being consolidated/built that ~2.5yr span (primary timer for Saturn-type charts)
Jupiter's yearly house = area of expansion/opportunity
2nd Saturn return (~age 58) framed as culmination/harvest, not endpoint
group years into phase-blocks with one theme each; label a launch window and a harvest window
when age_psychology stage aligns (Levinson/Saturn-return ages) cite it to lift confidence

offers.ru: Проверь карту по своей жизни: датированные переломы и вероятные смены места жительства
offers.en: Validate the chart against your life: dated pivots and likely relocations

steps: scan monthly: slow planets (Saturn/Uranus/Neptune/Pluto) conjunct natal ASC/MC/IC/DSC and Sun/Moon (orb <=1)
dedupe into event-windows (>~14 months apart = separate event)
flag IC / 4th-house-cusp crossings and Uranus/Neptune over ASC as RELOCATION markers
mark Saturn return and Uranus opposition (midlife) ages

rules: angle crossings = change-of-life-chapter markers; IC/4th = home/residence specifically
present as dated windows with a life-theme each, NOT as claimed biography
explicitly ask the user which windows landed and whether they were moves

validation_loop.note: When the user confirms a window, that window's insight upgrades from astrology_symbolic (0.8) to a convergence of astronomy + user_context (HIGH). Confirmed hits calibrate which of the user's sensitive points fire strongest, improving decade-map for the same user.

offers.ru: Лучшие часы дня для важного действия (разговор, подпись, старт)
offers.en: Best hours of a day for an important action

steps: Moon longitude per 30 min across waking hours (local tz)
Moon aspects to natal Sun/Mercury/relevant rulers (tight orb)
void-of-course detection (Moon's last aspect before sign change)
Moon phase (waxing/waning) for begin-vs-release framing

rules: waxing = beginnings/acquiring (e.g. move-in); waning = release/handover
Moon trine/sextile natal luminary = supportive personal window for the action
void-of-course hours flagged as 'do routine, avoid final commitments'
map action_type (contract/negotiation/move) to the ruler to watch (e.g. Mercury retrograde for contracts)

offers.ru: Опиши характер (или литературного героя) — получи промпт для генерации портрета
offers.en: Describe a character — get a face-generation prompt

computes.note: Not ephemeris: this reads the physiognomy KB (backend/services/physiognomy/knowledge_base/{mianxiang,western}.json) in REVERSE.
steps: map each character trait to KB face-type entries (mianxiang five-elements, Corman, Kretschmer, Lavater zones)
collect the implied facial features (face shape, cheekbones, gaze, brow, etc.)
compose a positive generation prompt + negative prompt in RU/EN

rules: traits -> features is a traditional-association mapping, labelled reflective, never claimed as fact about a real person
only fictional characters or the consenting user's self; never a third party (ethics_note)
output feeds scripts/generate_fandorin_portrait.py-style generators (openai gpt-image / google gemini)
